Usage: tokenPath → useTheme() dot-path, cssVar → --gds-* reference only (never emit in TSX). CamelCase split: borderRadiusXl → [border,Radius,Xl] → drop 'border' → radius.xl

$usage.keyQuestion: What GridKit radius token corresponds to this Figma border-radius variable or px value?
lookupSteps: 1. Figma variable name (camelCase): split on camelCase boundaries, drop 'border' prefix, lowercase → radius.<scale>. E.g. borderRadiusXL → radius.xl. See camelCaseSplitExamples for all worked examples.
2. px value only: query pxIndex['4px'] → tokenPath string (e.g. 'radius.sm'). Covers 0px through 9999px.
criticalRules: In TSX: always use theme.radius?.xl via useTheme(). Never var(--gds-radius-xl, 32px) or any CSS var string in JSX styling.
camelCaseSplitExamples contains all 8 radius variable name variants — check it before marking a variable as unmatched.

gds.border.radius.default.description: Default — base radius for most components (buttons, inputs, cards)

gds.border.radius.round.description: Pill / fully circular — clamped by CSS to half the smallest dimension, giving a perfect pill on wide text buttons and a perfect circle on square icon buttons

pxIndex.$comment: Reverse-lookup: raw value → tokenPath. Use when Figma emits a pixel value or CSS var with no variable name. '0' and '0px' both resolve to radius.none.

camelCaseSplitExamples.$comment: Figma variable names returned as camelCase from the Variables API. Split on camelCase boundaries, drop the 'border' prefix, lowercase → token dot-path.
